subject: KeystonePay: Console + API enablement — split-day proposal
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@keystonepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-08T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: KeystonePay: Interactive Console + API enablement — proposed dates

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier. To keep momentum, here are two proposed formats for the enablement so your engineers and product folks get hands-on without an overloaded day: 

Option A — Single full day (9:00–16:30 PT)
- Console walkthrough (9:00–11:30)
- Lunch / Q&A (11:30–12:30)
- API patterns + hands-on labs (12:30–16:30)

Option B — Split day (two half-day blocks)
- Day 1 (3 hours): Console + access validation (14:00–17:00 PT)
- Day 2 (3 hours): API enablement + integration patterns (10:00–13:00 PT)

We tend to recommend Option B when there are APAC participants or mixed seniority — it reduces cognitive load and gives your engineers time to try things between sessions. Attached is a short agenda and an access checklist so we can confirm service accounts and keys ahead of time.

Can you confirm which option works best for the KeystonePay team and share a list of expected attendees (and their timezones)? If Option B is preferred, propose two candidate dates and I’ll coordinate the invites and runbook prep (Ben will own the runbook and environment checks).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: keystone_onboard_agenda.pdf (overview, 2 pages); access_checklist.md (preflight list)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@keystonepay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-08T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KeystonePay: Interactive Console + API enablement — proposed dates

Sofia — thanks for the options and the docs. Quick context: our core infra and product leads are split between US and APAC (Singapore). A single full day will be rough for the APAC folks.

Can we do Option B but with the second block later in the day PT so it’s friendly for Singapore (i.e., 12:00–15:00 PT for Day 2)? We have these windows available:
- Week of Sep 22: Sep 23 (AM PT) or Sep 24 (PM PT)
- Week of Sep 29: Sep 30 (PM PT)

Attendees (tentative):
- Alex Morgan (Product) — Alex.Morgan@keystonepay.com (PT)
- Priya Singh (Platform Eng) — priya@keystonepay.com (SGT)
- Daniel Osei (Backend) — daniel@keystonepay.com (GMT)

We’ll confirm the final attendee list by Sep 15. Can Ben flag any known preflight requirements for an APAC-heavy session (Sofia noted access and keys)?

Appreciate the flexibility — Alex

Hi Alex — great, Option B sounds like the right fit. Proposed plan below with timezone alignment to keep the APAC team engaged: 

Final proposal (split-day bridge):
- Day 1 — Console + access validation: Sep 23, 2025, 14:00–17:00 PT (US-friendly afternoon)
- Day 2 — API enablement + labs: Sep 24, 2025, 12:00–15:00 PT (early evening SGT for APAC)

Action items:
- Alex: confirm the attendee list and who will need elevated access for hands-on labs (deadline: Sep 15)
- Priya / Daniel: confirm they can attend the Sep 24 time window
- Ben (cc): I’m attaching a runbook template — Ben, can you own the environment prep and post-session notes? Any special provisioning for Singapore-based attendees (e.g., VPN rules) we should flag now?

I’ll hold both calendar slots as tentative and send formal invites/Google Calendar links once the attendee list is confirmed. If those dates don’t work we can pivot to Sep 30 PM as Alex suggested.

Thanks,
Sofia

Attachments: runbook_template.docx

Alex / Sofia — I’ll own the runbook and provisioning. Quick notes: 

Preflight essentials I’ll check before Day 1:
- Confirm service account creation and RBAC (names + emails)
- API key provisioning and delivery method (we prefer secure calendar invite or Vault link)
- Sandbox dataset availability (we’ll seed a small sample set for the labs)
- VPN / IP allowlisting for Singapore hosts (if needed)

I’ll start a short checklist and post it to the shared doc (link above). Sofia — once Alex confirms attendees I’ll send a calendar invite with join info and a brief preflight survey (1–2 items) to speed verification.

Ben Carter
